name: resume-tailor
description: Tailor a resume + matching cover letter to a specific role from your real evidence. Honesty-graded (every claim carries its evidence and a verifiability grade), falsifier-gated (refuses to state what it can't defend), lead-with-strengths projected for the target JD, rendered print-safe with an ATS-plain companion, and run through an adversarial pre-send gauntlet.
